title: Titanic: Two Hours and Forty Minutes
topic: Titanic's maiden voyage, collision, and sinking

sources.title: The National Archives · Life Aboard the Titanic
Royal Museums Greenwich · RMS Titanic fact sheet

scenes.title: The maiden voyage
scenes.narration: On her maiden voyage, Titanic sailed west from Southampton. New York was her destination.
scenes.visualDescription: A four-funnel liner steams west on a quiet sea.

visualDirection.lighting: Low silver light along the horizon
visualDirection.composition: Ship to the right with negative space for titles on the left

factChecks.note: The maiden voyage left Southampton on 10 April 1912 for New York.

scenes.title: An iceberg in the dark
scenes.narration: Late on April fourteenth, nineteen twelve, Titanic struck an iceberg.
scenes.visualDescription: A ridge of ice comes into view in the dark beyond the ship.

visualDirection.shotType: Side view of the approaching hazards
visualDirection.lighting: Cold light catches the iceberg edge
visualDirection.composition: Ship and iceberg to the right, with both silhouettes clear of the text

factChecks.note: The museum chronology places the collision at 23:40 on 14 April 1912.

scenes.title: Beneath the Atlantic
scenes.narration: Two hours and forty minutes later, the ship slipped beneath the Atlantic.
scenes.visualDescription: The liner's silhouette sinks into a dark waterline.

visualDirection.lighting: Faint blue edge light and a dark waterline
visualDirection.composition: Low ship silhouette to the right with clear space for the closing title
visualDirection.background: Night sky fading into the horizon

factChecks.note: The ship foundered at 02:20 on 15 April, two hours and forty minutes after the 23:40 collision.
